aboutText: Serv Auto Care Service is Fawkner's premier car service and repair centre, owned and operated by head mechanic Serv Auto Care Service. With a highly qualified team of automotive repair technicians, we promise satisfaction in every job. Our modern workshop at 18 Leo St, Fawkner, is equipped to handle all your vehicle needs, from routine servicing to complex repairs, serving the local community with dedication.
servicesText: Serv Auto Care Service offers a wide range of automotive services and repairs. Our skilled technicians use the latest diagnostic tools and genuine parts to keep your car running smoothly. From logbook servicing to major overhauls, we cover all aspects of vehicle maintenance in Fawkner and surrounding areas.

services.title: Logbook Servicing
services.desc: Manufacturer-specified servicing to maintain your vehicle's warranty and ensure optimal performance on the road.

services.title: Brake Repairs
services.desc: Complete brake inspections, pad replacements, and rotor resurfacing for safe and reliable stopping power.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics
services.desc: Advanced computer diagnostics to quickly identify and fix engine issues, preventing costly breakdowns.

services.title: Suspension & Steering
services.desc: Expert repair and alignment services to ensure a smooth, stable ride and improve vehicle handling.

services.title: Exhaust Systems
services.desc: Installation, repair, and upgrade of exhaust systems to meet emission standards and enhance performance.

services.title: Transmission Repair
services.desc: Comprehensive service for automatic and manual transmissions to ensure optimal shifting and longevity.
